# ui::AnimatedIconSource

Header: `winui/render/AnimatedVisualSource.hpp`.

Derives from `ui::AnimatedVisualSource`.

[AnimatedIcon](../controls/animated-icon.md#uianimatedicon)'s source interface: an [AnimatedVisualSource](animated-visual-source.md) with named markers, each mapping a state name (such as "PointerOver") to the normalized progress point of that state's pose. [AnimatedIconControl::set_state()](../controls/animated-icon.md#set_state) looks the requested state up here and animates toward its progress. A state with no matching marker leaves the current pose alone. The icon's color arrives as [render_icon_frame()](#render_icon_frame)'s `foreground`.

Implement it: draw your icon in [render_icon_frame()](#render_icon_frame) and hand it to an [AnimatedIcon](../controls/animated-icon.md#uianimatedicon).

Example: 
```cpp
class PulseIcon final : public ui::AnimatedIconSource
{
public:
    PulseIcon()
    {
        markers_["Normal"]      = 0.0;
        markers_["PointerOver"] = 0.5;
        markers_["Pressed"]     = 1.0;
    }
    [[nodiscard]] ui::Size natural_size() const override { return {24.0f, 24.0f}; }
    [[nodiscard]] ui::Duration duration() const override { return ui::Duration{900.0}; }
    void render_frame(ui::Renderer& r, const ui::Rect& b, double progress) const override
    {
        render_icon_frame(r, b, progress, ui::colors::Black);
    }
    void render_icon_frame(ui::Renderer& r, const ui::Rect& b, double progress,
                           const ui::Color& foreground) const override
    {
        const float radius = 12.0f * static_cast<float>(progress);
        r.fill_ellipse(b.center(), radius, radius, foreground);
    }
    [[nodiscard]] const std::unordered_map<std::string, double>& markers() const override
    {
        return markers_;
    }

private:
    std::unordered_map<std::string, double> markers_;
};

static const PulseIcon pulse;
auto icon = std::make_unique<ui::AnimatedIconControl>();
icon->set_source(&pulse);
icon->set_state("PointerOver"); // animates from 0 toward 0.5
```

## markers

```cpp
virtual const std::unordered_map<std::string, double>& markers() const = 0
```

[State](../controls/content-host.md#uistate) name to the normalized progress (0..1) its pose sits at. [Transition](../tree/namespace-ui.md#transition) segments such as `NormalToPointerOver_Start`/`_End` are markers too; [AnimatedIcon](../controls/animated-icon.md#uianimatedicon) prefers them.

## render_icon_frame

```cpp
virtual void render_icon_frame(Renderer& renderer, const Rect& bounds, double progress, const Color&) const
```

[render_frame()](animated-visual-source.md#render_frame) in the icon's foreground color, which [AnimatedIcon](../controls/animated-icon.md#uianimatedicon) passes with every draw. The source doesn't store the color, because one source object is shared by every icon showing it. A source with no themable color keeps this default, which ignores `foreground`.
